task: Using the supplied B1, B8, and dB2 BaO phase-volume structures, independently determine the stable phase sequence between 0 and 80 GPa and estimate both crossover pressures. Select and validate the periodic electronic-structure, relaxation, EOS/enthalpy, refinement, and uncertainty workflow without a disclosed paper method.
scientific_mode_description: The scientific question and raw input boundary are fixed, but no paper method, software sequence, parameter protocol, candidate pathway, or stopping route is disclosed.
scientific_requirements: Choose and justify the periodic method, volume sampling, relaxation, and adaptive crossover strategy.
Use compatible periodic settings and normalize energies/enthalpies per BaO formula unit.
Validate structural identity after relaxation and do not silently compare collapsed phases.
Quantify convergence and interpolation uncertainty for every crossover claim.
Use fixed-volume internal-coordinate relaxation where required by residual-force checks.
When server resources allow, parallelize independent calculations and use substantial CPU and memory resources without oversubscribing the host.

required_deliverables.description: Initial hypotheses, software DAG, budgets, gates, and stopping rules.
One provenance record for every chemistry-software invocation.
Failed, rejected, retried, or inconclusive branches.
Space group, normalization, volume, and structural checks.
VASP energies, stresses, convergence, and per-formula-unit normalization.
Fitted enthalpy curves and adaptive crossover evidence.
Phase sequence, transition estimates, and numerical uncertainty.
Artifact-linked paper-reproduction report and uncertainty analysis.

data.name: Autonomous multi-software research inputs
data.description: The same B1, B8, and dB2 phase-volume structures and pressure range as the guided track; no paper method, EOS route, or transition pressure.
